whatIs: 404s is a curated gallery of creative 404 error pages from real sites. Each card shows a screenshot and leads to a page with a link to the live page.

You browse it with the Latest and Top 4 tabs, a shuffle button, a search with a filter and a monthly archive with the four best of each month. It's useful when you want an error to stop being an empty screen.
uses: Looking for ideas to design your project's 404 page with illustration, humor or animation.
Showing a client examples of well-executed errors to justify design time on that screen.
Seeing how other sites offer a useful way out (search, links or a back button) from an error.
caveats: Filtering is limited to a search, the sort order, shuffle and the monthly archive; there are no thematic categories.
It shows the visual result, not the code, so you handle the implementation.
Some linked 404 pages may change or disappear if the original site is redesigned.
pricingNote: Open browsing with no paid plans.
